text: (Government Aided Autonomous Institution Affiliated to Anna University)
Modern web applications combine responsive interfaces, backend services, databases and AI-enabled workflows.
Kealvi is a live audience workspace designed for creating polls, collecting votes and viewing results in real time.
The application brings poll creation, saved and shared polls, leaderboard, insights and activity alerts into one workspace.
The project demonstrates full-stack development with a responsive interface for desktop and mobile users.
Create → Vote → Observe live results → Decide
Teams, classrooms, communities and live sessions
Fast interaction with clear feedback on every action

Many audience-engagement workflows are fragmented across forms, chat messages and separate analytics tools. This makes it harder to run a quick poll, track participation and interpret the result immediately.
Poll creation, voting and result review may happen in different tools, increasing friction for both organizers and participants.
Without a shared live view, teams cannot quickly see response distribution, active polls or participation signals.
Raw responses alone do not show trends, engagement level, activity history or contributor rankings in a compact way.
Need: a single responsive workspace that supports poll creation, live voting, organization, analytics and activity tracking.
Compose questions, add options, choose category and set closing time.
Allow participants to vote and see result distribution update clearly.
Provide All polls, My polls, Voted and Saved views with search and filters.
Show leaderboard, engagement indicators, response distribution and activity feed.
Deliver a responsive desktop and mobile interface with consistent navigation.
Use Gemini-assisted topic generation to speed up poll creation.

Interface patterns observed from the supplied Apple TV analysis
The interface emphasizes discovery first, then reduces the number of steps required to resume, save or search content.
APPLE TV — LIBRARY, ACCOUNT, STAKEHOLDERS & SERVICES
• Customers streaming movies and TV shows
• Store managers handling purchases and rentals
Apple TV foregrounds Play/Add. Kealvi similarly keeps Create poll / New poll visible in the header and composer.
Apple TV uses stable bottom navigation. Kealvi keeps major destinations consistent across desktop and mobile.
Apple TV Library mirrors a familiar pattern for Saved polls and My polls.
Category cards and search inspire Kealvi search, category/status filters and shared-poll views.
Apple TV uses clear active tabs and state changes; Kealvi uses vote confirmation, closed states and empty states.
Apple Account centralizes identity/settings; Kealvi uses a display name and contributor-based activity/leaderboard.
Kealvi integrates poll creation, live voting, result visualization, organization, analytics and activity tracking in a single responsive workspace.
The project demonstrates practical full-stack integration using modern frontend tools, Supabase data services and Gemini-assisted drafting.
Desktop and mobile screenshots show consistent navigation, clear state feedback and reusable card-based UI patterns.
The Apple TV deconstruction helped identify effective interface patterns such as strong primary actions, persistent navigation, saved-content views and fast discovery.
Outcome: a clean, data-driven audience engagement application that turns opinions into visible, actionable results.
